CustomField.description: WLR-calculated labor minutes for this line item: Quantity × WLR Standard Minutes_Per_Unit. Falls back to legacy Time_Standard__c if WLR_Standard__c lookup is blank. Zero if both are missing (flags Duration_Calc_Status__c as Missing Standard).
CustomField.formula: IF( WLR_Standard__r.Minutes_Per_Unit__c != null, ROUND(Quantity__c * WLR_Standard__r.Minutes_Per_Unit__c, 0), IF( Time_Standard__c != null, ROUND(Quantity__c * Time_Standard__c, 0), 0 ) )
CustomField.label: Estimated Line Minutes
